types.description: C60N miniature circuit breaker, 1 pole, 6 A, B curve

document.title: Low voltage — Multi 9, Low Voltage Final Distribution Products 0.5A to 125A
document.pages: Printed pp.8–9 (physical PDF pp.7–8); 1P diagram and exact 24049 row on printed p.9

modelingNotes: Exact 24049 selection row and its 1P diagram establish terminal markings 1 and 2. Standalone breaker only; no separately ordered auxiliary is included.
6 A B curve calibrated at 30 °C; magnetic operation 3–5 In. Trip behavior is not simulated.
Ue 440 V AC, Ui 500 V AC, Uimp 6 kV are manufacturer capabilities, not assigned circuit nominal voltage. No nominal_voltage or voltage_type is imposed.

1P IEC 60898 Icn 6000 A at catalog 230/400 V. IEC 60947-2 Icu 10 kA at 230–240 V; 3 kA at 400–415 V only for the specified single-pole IT isolated-neutral double-fault condition. No unconditional breaking-capacity scalar is modeled.
Tunnel terminals: up to 16 mm² flexible or 25 mm² rigid for ratings up to 25 A (2011 catalog).

Reverse feeding is permitted by Schneider Multi 9 System Catalog, 03/2008, printed p.26 (physical p.5), manufacturer-authored mirror https://docs.rs-online.com/0054/0900766b813b9128.pdf. Terminal roles therefore do not constrain feed direction.
Open contact state follows the catalog schematic, not an as-built state. The switching pole is not a fixed conductive link. Terminal connections are application-dependent.

connectionCoverage.notes: Standalone 1P order: two documented power terminals 1 and 2. No neutral, PE, signal, communication or auxiliary terminals in its circuit diagram. Separately ordered auxiliaries excluded.

1.description: Marked terminal 1; upper endpoint in manufacturer schematic; reversible feed

2.description: Marked terminal 2; lower endpoint in manufacturer schematic; reversible feed
